description: The transaction was included in a block (inclusion proof would verify) but reverted (receiptStatus=0). The precompile only proves inclusion, not success (PRD v2 Appendix D known boundary) — instantiate must check the receipt itself and create no capacity for a reverted create.
note: Real Gate 1 stream's fields, with receiptStatus flipped to 0 to model a reverted create. No real reverted Sablier tx was used — this is the documented negative case.
